title: Decision
description: A single entry in the KeepMees decision register (docs/ops/decision-register.md)

id.description: Unique decision ID matching the register format (e.g. DEC-P-01, DEC-V-08)

status.description: Current authority status of this decision

constraints.description: Downstream constraints created by this decision

supersededBy.description: If superseded, the ID of the superseding decision

stream.description: Source stream that produced or approved this decision

lockedSince.description: Phase or package when this decision was locked

requiresVersionBump.description: True if changing this decision requires bumping BOOK_PAGINATION_VERSION
